items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I never met the woman in my life. I mean, I [unclear] like her singing, but I mean, I would have given her respect.

ctx.x: No, no. I played for her a lot of times. We‘d be hanging out or something. No, we never worked together. And Carmen, we just met through music. Carmen used to come to see me all the time. She came one night, I was at a place on P Street, a beautiful hotel, had big chandeliers and stuff, and the guy who owned the club was a big fan. His name is Fred White, and he‘s still got a club down on 17th and [unclear] Avenue. So I‘m sitting there and playing, and it was quiet, and I‘m singing some love song, and this Anita…
